title: Build owner session bootstrap and responsive CRM shell
requirements: Create a dependency-free owner UI under apps/web/owner/**, separate from the public landing page.

Implement login against POST /api/v1/admin/session with credentials: include, application/json and X-Requested-With: crm; keep csrf_token runtime-only and never use localStorage, sessionStorage or logs for it.
Bootstrap with GET /api/v1/admin/session using credentials: include; render the owner shell only after success. A 401 returns the login view; network and 5xx responses expose a retry state.
Implement logout with DELETE /api/v1/admin/session, credentials: include and X-CSRF-Token; clear runtime state after completion and return to login.
Provide a simple responsive Russian shell with keyboard-visible focus, labels, aria-live/alert feedback and navigation placeholders for «Заявки» and «Календарь» without implementing their data.

Add dependency-free contract/unit tests in tests/web002a/** covering endpoints, headers, credentials, runtime-only CSRF, 401/retry behavior, logout and responsive/accessibility markers. Do not add bundler, dependencies, backend route, deployment or bot code.
acceptance: A configured owner can log in, see a responsive CRM shell, and sign out through the accepted session API.
Session and CSRF handling follows the browser contract without persistent token storage or credential leakage.
Unauthenticated and unavailable states are explicit and recoverable; placeholders do not claim implemented inquiry/calendar data.
Focused offline tests and whitespace checks pass within allowed paths.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow browser adapter for already implemented owner session routes; public landing and backend remain out of scope.
